name: The Ring's Destiny
source:
In this game. you’ll take on the role of a young man who finds himself thrust into a world of danger and intrigue.
As the story begins, you’ll meet our hero, guy who is suddenly asked by his teacher to engage in a duel with her.
After he emerges victorious, the teacher reveals to him a shocking secret,
which sets him on a path to uncover the truth about his family’s past.
Determined to seek justice and find his purpose, the protagonist embarks on a journey to the capital city,
accompanied by his childhood friend and his teacher.
